strip_greek_diacritics
helpers.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.strip_greek_diacritics(p_text text)
 RETURNS text
 LANGUAGE sql
 IMMUTABLE STRICT
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  SELECT lower(
    normalize(
      regexp_replace(
        normalize(p_text, NFKD),
        '[\u0300-\u036F\u1DC0-\u1DFF\u1F00-\u1FFF.,;:·"᾽᾿῀῁]',
        '',
        'g'
      ),
      NFC
    )
  );
$function$

helpers.name: strip_hebrew_all
helpers.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.strip_hebrew_all(p_text text)
 RETURNS text
 LANGUAGE sql
 IMMUTABLE STRICT
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  SELECT normalize(
    regexp_replace(
      normalize(p_text, NFKD),
      '[\u0591-\u05C7\u0300-\u036F\u1DC0-\u1DFF׃־/]',
      '',
      'g'
    ),
    NFC
  );
$function$
